subject: peek_ewald_inpcrd: Box info not found in inpcrd

messages.author: Sunita Patel
messages.body:
Dear All,
In a simulation a DNA bound protein with Mg and Na ions are simulated in
water. I minimized the structure 3 times. Subsequently, added Na+ and water
using AMBER18 and then performed energy minimization of the whole system.
After energy minimization I ran NVT equilibration. During this I got the
following error.
Please help to rectify it. Where to check about the box information?
| Flags: MPI
getting new box info from bottom of inpcrd
| INFO: Old style inpcrd file read
| peek_ewald_inpcrd: Box info not found in inpcrd
Thank you for the help.
Sunita

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Apr 09, 2020, Sunita Patel wrote:
> getting new box info from bottom of inpcrd
>| INFO: Old style inpcrd file read
>
>| peek_ewald_inpcrd: Box info not found in inpcrd
Look at the last line of your inpcrd file: does it have box information?
Double-check your filenames: a common cause of this message is that you
gave some other file than the restart file from the minimization as the
file named in the -c flag.
....dac

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Apr 09, 2020, Sunita Patel wrote:
>
>Last few lines of system_EM.rst file
> 9.3683764 12.0844517 15.0382198 8.6494519 12.8704741 13.9743196
> 16.0011108 11.2811455 14.1604478 16.6792008 10.5808002 14.2140069
> 16.2855876 11.8563769 14.9115764
There is no box information there: box info would have 6 numbers on the
final line (3 box dimensions and 3 angles, typically 90.0 or 109.).
Did you set up the prmtop file with periodic boundary conditions? Did
you set ntb=1 when you ran the minimizations?
Run parmed on your prmtop file, and issue the "summary" command: does it
list a system volume? If not, the prmtop itself is not set up for
periodic simulations. If yet, then something is wrong with your restart
file.
....dac
